description: Implementation of file handling functions for Windows platform, including file operations such as read, write, seek, get length, set length, lock, unlock, and duplication, within the 'base' namespace.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class providing file operations such as read, write, seek, get/set length, lock, unlock, and duplication on Windows.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the file handle is valid.

methods.name: GetPlatformFile
methods.description: Returns the underlying platform-specific file handle.

methods.name: TakePlatformFile
methods.description: Transfers ownership of the platform-specific file handle.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the file handle if valid.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Moves the file pointer to a specified offset based on 'whence'.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified offset.

methods.name: ReadAtCurrentPos
methods.description: Reads data at the current file position.

methods.name: ReadNoBestEffort
methods.description: Reads data from a specified offset, with a placeholder for separate tracing.

methods.name: ReadAtCurrentPosNoBestEffort
methods.description: Reads data at current position, with a placeholder for separate tracing.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data at a specified offset.

methods.name: WriteAtCurrentPos
methods.description: Writes data at the current file position.

methods.name: WriteAtCurrentPosNoBestEffort
methods.description: Writes data at current position, with a placeholder for separate tracing.

methods.name: GetLength
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: SetLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the file, extending or truncating as needed.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves file information such as size, attributes, and timestamps.

methods.name: Duplicate
methods.description: Creates a duplicate handle of the current file handle.
